description: Header file providing utility functions for SocketCAN support, including translation between socketcan and can frame/filter structures.

methods.name: socketcan_to_can_frame
methods.description: Converts a socketcan_frame struct to a can_frame struct.

methods.name: socketcan_from_can_frame
methods.description: Converts a can_frame struct to a socketcan_frame struct.

methods.name: socketcan_to_can_filter
methods.description: Converts a socketcan_filter struct to a can_filter struct.

methods.name: socketcan_from_can_filter
methods.description: Converts a can_filter struct to a socketcan_filter struct.
